# Rush 2: Extreme Racing USA (US), recorded by N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs from web/shader_plan.json in
# headless Chrome. The plan walks the menus by the game's own state (game_state 0x8010C0D0, front_end_screen 0x800E7BC4, the
# track select's shown entry 0x803D05B4; docs/menus.md), keys held 150 ms (A Space, B Left Shift, Start Enter, the d-pad the
# arrows, the stick A and D). Section 0 is the launcher, the boot logos and the title; menus (in section 0 too) the race-type
# rows, Select Player, every track on the track select and the car select; attract the title's demos; then a race on each
# of the 7 tracks with the gas held and a weave, about 50 s each, and the first stunt course. The last 8 of attract are
# what the page missed in plays of web/play_plan_extended.json: the pause menu over a race and its QUIT, and a race's.
